_comment: PLACEHOLDER ARTWORK — the SVGs in assets/designs/ are generated stand-ins and are ALL attributed to the house line on purpose: putting a guest artist's name on work they did not make would be a false credit. Assign artistId to a real artist only when that artist's own file is in assets/designs/. `placement` names a print position defined per garment in catalog.json (frontCentre | leftChest | fullFront), or an object keyed by garment id, e.g. {"tee":"leftChest","cap":"frontCentre"}. `knockout` ('white'|'black') drops a flat artwork background to transparency so a PNG with no alpha does not print as a rectangle; `knockoutTol` (default 28) widens or tightens that cut.

designs.title: Ripple Field
designs.blurb: The wave field from the shader, held still. Forty-six rings collapsing towards a single point of light.
designs.story: Pulled straight from the interference pattern that runs behind this site. What the screen does in motion, cotton has to do in one frame — so the frame was chosen carefully.

designs.title: Chrome Fold
designs.blurb: A liquid-metal mass caught mid-fold, with the ghost of where it just was trailing behind it.
designs.story: Metal that hasn't decided whether it is solid yet. The trailing outlines are the same shape, one frame earlier, seven times over.

designs.title: Prism Split
designs.blurb: White light broken into twenty-six bars. A spectrum read as a skyline.
designs.story: The refraction pass of the shader, sampled column by column and stacked vertically.

designs.title: Aperture
designs.blurb: A hard sun. Forty-eight rays on a black pupil — the one design that holds its shape at any size.
designs.story: Built to survive being shrunk onto a cap front. Everything decorative was removed until only the silhouette carried it.
